item.title: Harris on History: When a school closes, what happens to its history?
item.description: by Wesley Harris By any measure, the closure of schools and the construction of new ones are civic milestones. Modern classrooms, advanced technology, safer facilities, and expanded athletic and arts spaces promise opportunity for a new generation of students.
